stories.headline: Europe’s tallest statue of Mary blessed in Poland. “She directs us toward God”
stories.summary: A towering sculpture of the Virgin Mary exceeding 180 feet in height was formally consecrated on August 15 in Konotopie, Poland. Standing as the continent's largest Marian landmark, the site provides a new setting for quiet petition and worship. During the dedication, Bishop Krzysztof Wętkowski noted that the grand structure is intended to guide hearts and minds toward the divine.
